title: Bears put DL Kentavius Street on injured reserve

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears put DL Kentavius Street on injured reserve
sources.description: The Bears saw defensive lineman Kentavius Street leave Monday night's win over the Seahawks with a knee injury and it is going to keep him out for an extended period of time.
